description: Introduction to concurrent computing, including the specification, implementation, and analysis of concurrent systems. Topics include: theoretical models of concurrency; software design patterns for parallel applications; programming languages and frameworks for expressing concurrency; and verification techniques for concurrent programs.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of:
    • CSC360 - Operating Systems (1.5)
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 464, CSC 485C (if taken in same topic), CSC 564, CSC 586C (if taken in same topic).
  • May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
title: Concurrency
